'''Fost Bramsin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] Bramsin conspired with the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] Senator [[Haydnat Treen]], [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] of [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command]] to [[Lecersen Conspiracy|overthrow]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]. During this time, he played a game of [[Chambers/Legends|chambers]] with Treen, Jaxton, and Lecersen. In [[44 ABY]], he was one of a hundred Coruscanti [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] who participated in the [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]] held by [[Booster Terrik]]. Eventually when the conspiracy started to unravel, Bramsin was murdered by his old friend, Treen, who believed that he might inadvertently reveal some of the conspiracy's most crucial secrets.
